Die Position
  
  
Project Manager
  
Roche India - Roche Services& Solutions
  
Hyderabad
  
  
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  
That’s what makes us Roche
  
  
Mission
  
  
Roche Services& Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing an OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai& Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.
  
  
AsProject Manager you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization and report to the Chapter Lead for Project Management. Are you a project management enthusiast and want to provide best in class project management services to partners across Roche? Then you are the candidate we are looking for.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Engagement Delivery
  
  
In this role you will be responsible for successful Project Delivery using agile or traditional project management methodology.
  
  
**Your work will include but will not be limited to:**  

* understanding the business goal(s) and value of the project and striving to deliver the defined benefits to the organization
* leading or being part of global project teams ensuring clear roles and responsibilities and resource assignment to the project plan deliverables
* ensuring that the critical success factors of reliability, compliance, efficiency, sustainability, time to value are managed throughout the entire lifecycle of the projects
* effectively managing stakeholders through the establishment of key relationships and developing an understanding of their organizations
* generating, maintaining and tracking an accurate and realistic project plan, project risk and issue log and ensuring the project status is timely and transparent
* preparing and presenting to relevant governance meetings as required by the project methodology and good project management practice
* tracking project financials and seek governance approval when needed
* applying organizational change management practices as needed and ensuring effective project communication
* contributing to business development opportunities where appropriate

Capability Building
  
  

* Be an active member of the Project Management Chapter by:
* Continuously improving the project management capabilities, service offerings and community engagement leveraging latest developments and market dynamics
* Supporting the development of training content and toolkits for our team
* Actively managing your project management upskilling
* Applying your learnings during engagements and sharing them with your RSS colleagues

Who you are
  
  
You possess the following qualifications, experience and personal attributes:
  
  

* Appropriate university degree and5+ years of project management related work experience
* Strong knowledge in project management fundamentals (waterfall, SCRUM and others) and related tools
* Experience in leading global/complex projects, organizing and optimizing resources and establishing clear priorities
* Ability to motivate and lead a project team or team members if required
* Excellent communication skills, with demonstrated proficiency in influencing, negotiating, and effective global collaboration.
* Ability to effectively communicate across various levels of a complex, matrix organization. Ideally exposure to an additional field related to project management, such as project change management, business consulting, methodology coaching.
* Experience in project management financials and resource management

In addition, the following skills will make you successful in your position and create the foundation for career growth at Roche:
  
  

* Customer centricity
* Collaborative ways of working
* Presentation and influencing skills
* Business acumen& systems thinking

Wer wir sind
  
  
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  
Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  
Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

**Budgeting & Estimation**

* Rate analysis and benchmarking against prevailing Chennai and Bangalore market rates; build and maintain an internal rate library.
* Develop cost per seat and cost per sq.ft. benchmarks by centre and by scope, and provide fit-out cost inputs for client proposals and landlord negotiations.

**Planning & Scheduling**

* Prepare project schedules identifying the critical path and the activities that must run in sequence versus in parallel.
* Prepare procurement and material delivery schedules aligned to the construction programme.
* Track actual progress against baseline, flag slippage early and prepare recovery plans.
* Maintain look-ahead plans and daily and weekly progress reporting.

**Tendering & Procurement**

* Prepare tender documents, float RFQs and RFIs, and run pre-bid clarifications.
* Prepare technical and commercial comparative statements and recommend award.
* Draft work orders with unambiguous scope, rates, measurement basis, payment terms and timelines.
* Identify and develop new vendors and contractors across civil, MEP and specialist trades.

**Measurement, Billing & Certification**

* Carry out joint measurement at site and record measurements in the measurement book.
* Verify contractor RA bills against the BOQ, work order rates and actual site measurement, and certify for payment.
* Maintain deviation and variation statements with rate justification for non-BOQ and extra items.
* Reconcile free-issue and client-supplied material.
* Track advances, retention, recoveries, debit notes, and final bill settlement and closure.
* Coordinate with finance for release of payments against certification.

**QA / QC**

* Prepare and enforce inspection and test plans, stage-wise quality checklists and the material approval process.
* Check executed work against drawings, specifications and approved samples at each stage.
* Conduct pre-handover testing – electrical load and earthing, HVAC balancing and airflow, fire system testing, plumbing pressure testing, network certification and access control commissioning.
* Prepare and close snag lists; complete handover documentation including as-builts, warranties, O&M manuals and asset registers.

**Cost Control & Reporting**

* Track estimated versus actual cost line by line; maintain a variation register and flag overruns before they are incurred.
* Identify value-engineering opportunities and quantify the saving and the trade-off.
* Prepare monthly MIS on cost, schedule and quality across all live projects.
* Prepare decision notes and options analyses for management on technical and commercial matters.

* Act as the technical point of contact for management – site inspections, technical assessment of prospective buildings, and assessment of landlord fit-out obligations and base-build condition.

* Experience with a PMC, design-build contractor, IPC, developer, or a retail / flex-space rollout operator, handling commercial interior fit-out projects.

5 – 8 yrs, including at least 2 – 3 yrs of direct site execution.

₹7.00L – ₹10.00L p.a.
